prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object approached, take it, check its properties, move. If not visible, approach. If not found, scan.     list of available nodes: <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = MoveRobot    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO MoveRobot
	END
